scope: Fictional staging assessment for demonstrating the report. No live tests were performed.
limitations: All sample items are invented teaching data, not findings about any real app.

items.title: A private test note appears in another account
items.rating_reason: Fictional example: one ordinary account can repeat a simple read and receive another account's private marker.
items.evidence: SAMPLE ONLY: fictional marker NOTE-B-123 returned in a simulated account A read.
items.consequence: Private notes could be disclosed between customers.
items.fix: Authorize the current user against the record and workspace in the server-side read.
items.retest: Repeat the cross-account read and confirm owner access still works.

items.title: A second private-record route has the same mistake
items.rating_reason: Fictional example uses the same ease and impact so marker overlap handling can be demonstrated.
items.evidence: SAMPLE ONLY: a second simulated route returned a fictional attachment marker.
items.fix: Apply the same ownership rule to attachment reads.
items.retest: Repeat with the wrong account, owner account, and signed-out session.

items.title: Public error includes an internal filename
items.rating_reason: Fictional example requires an unusual input and reveals a filename without a secret.
items.evidence: SAMPLE ONLY: simulated error contains an internal filename, with no private data.
items.consequence: May give someone clues about the implementation.
items.fix: Return a generic public error and retain details in restricted logs.
items.retest: Repeat the input and verify the public response is generic.

items.title: Signed-out private record request is rejected
items.evidence: SAMPLE ONLY: simulated response contained no marker.
items.consequence: This simulated check prevented a signed-out read.
items.fix: Keep this check as a regression test.

items.title: Password-reset account binding needs another check
items.evidence: SAMPLE ONLY: no completed cross-account reset was demonstrated.
items.consequence: Impact cannot be confirmed from the available evidence.
items.fix: Run a controlled check with two disposable accounts and inboxes.
items.retest: Record the account that actually changes.

items.title: Payment fulfillment was outside the test scope
items.evidence: SAMPLE ONLY: no payment checks were run.
items.fix: Arrange a provider sandbox test before assessing this feature.
items.retest: Use a fictional product and verify the order, payment, and access.
